title: YOLO11m model compared with physician panels for rotator cuff tears on MRI
summary: A locked YOLO11m model classified posterosuperior rotator cuff MRI as intact, partial or full-thickness tear in 258 arthroscopy-referenced patients, with accuracy 0.841 (95% CI 0.792-0.881). It outperformed senior-resident (0.729) and junior-resident (0.671) panels, and did not differ significantly from specialist panels (senior specialists 0.911, Holm p=0.060). The study is single-center and retrospective, and equivalence to specialists is not established.
ai_technology: YOLO11m deep learning model for three-category rotator cuff MRI classification

evidence.tested: Blinded multi-reader comparison against arthroscopy; separate 300-patient development set.
evidence.unknown: Benefit of AI-assisted reading and generalization beyond one center are not established; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: Classified rotator cuff integrity from MRI.
